title: Banzaï (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
Michel Bernardin works for “Planet Assistance”, which helps travellers in need. On his first assignment, Michel goes to North Africa to get a man out of the hospital but ends up with the wrong man and accidentally sets off a coup d’état. In New York, he is attacked by men in Harlem
while trying to bring a musician back. Lastly, he goes to Hong Kong, where he comes across his fiancée but is also an unwitting puppet of some racketeers.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: Michel Bernardin任職於Planet Assistance公司，專門協助有需要的旅客。他接到的第一項任務，是前往北非把一名男子從醫院帶出來，結果卻帶錯了人，還無意中觸發政變。在紐約，他本想帶一名音樂家回國，卻在哈林區遭人襲擊。最後，他來到香港，重遇未婚妻，卻又在不知不覺間淪為一夥不法之徒的扯線公仔。
